svg.title: Dependent steps cannot retrieve their input
svg.desc: Fan several dependent steps into the same empty file slot. Their external retrieval routes stop at the perimeter, making one missing input responsible for multiple blocked steps. Visual distinction: A solid tiled network wall with disconnected cable ends. Indicates unavailable reach, not a decision awaiting human approval.
